title: VibTools Product Catalog Manifest Specification
description: Schema for vibtools.json manifests used for auto-discovering and importing projects into VibTools catalog portals, with support for social OG cards and non-technical documentation.

subtitle.description: Short primary tag or subtitle (e.g. 'Windows, Automation, Utility').

description.description: Comprehensive explanation of what the tool or product does.

logoUrl.description: Square logo image URL or relative path.

thumbnailUrl.description: Banner or preview thumbnail image URL or relative path.

ogImageUrl.description: Social OpenGraph / Twitter card preview image URL or relative path (1200x630 recommended).

ogImage.description: Social OpenGraph preview image URL or relative path (alias for ogImageUrl).

screenshots.description: Array of screenshot image URLs or relative paths.

assets.description: Visual branding and media assets, including social OG images and logos.

quickStart.description: Path or URL to the Quick Start guide for non-technical users (e.g. 'vibtools/quick-start.md').

quick-start.description: Path or URL to the Quick Start guide (kebab-case alias).

features.description: Path or URL to the product features and overview document for end users (e.g. 'vibtools/features.md').

faq.description: Path or URL to frequently asked questions (e.g. 'vibtools/faq.md').

whatsNew.description: Path or URL to what's new and release highlights for non-technical users (e.g. 'vibtools/whats-new.md').

whats-new.description: Path or URL to what's new document (kebab-case alias).

documents.description: Paths or URLs to non-technical documentation and user-facing guides (quick-start, features, FAQ, what's new).

liveDemo.description: URL to live demo or hosted web app.

download.description: Direct download link or release installer URL.

links.description: External resource links and download locations.

isFeatured.description: Featured highlight on homepage or top rankings.
